To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the moduli space of non-Abelian vortex solutions is a complex manifold of complex dimension equal to twice the number of broken generators of the gauge group, and is a smooth manifold if the gauge group is simple and has no nontrivial outer automorphisms.
the moduli space of a vortex in a non‐Abelman gauge theory with arbitrary gauge groups and a Fayet‐Ilipolis term is a complex torus, which is a product of complex tori.

the moduli space of a vortex solution of a U(1) gauge field coupled to a non‐Abelial gauge theory in the color‐flavor locking vacuum is a product of the moduli space for the U(1) theory, the moduli space corresponding to the gauge field in the non‐Abelian theory, and the moduli space describing the fluctuations of the scalar fields.
